meeting_point: H&M Landing (2803 Emerson Street San Diego, CA 92106)
location_address: 2803 Emerson Street San Diego, CA US 92106
description: 🌴☀️ Enjoy a fun, tropical tiki-themed private charter with up to 13 guests. Includes a USCG licensed captain, host & bartender. 🍹
what_is_included:
🌺 USCG licensed captain, host, and bartender.
🌺 All gas, marina and port fees included.
🌺 Alcohol available for purchase (premium Cutwater spirits, beer, and hard seltzer).
🌺 Bluetooth sound system - listen to our Tiki tunes or play your own!
🌺 Bathroom on board.
what_is_not_included:
🌺 Alcohol (available for purchase on board). **No BYOB permitted.**
🌺 Food (guests are welcome to bring their own). No cooking or heating permitted on board. 
🌺 Trip insurance (optional for $85). Trip insurance must be selected and paid for at time of checkout. It cannot be selected after your charter deposit has been made.	
🌺 A $150 cleaning fee hold will be placed on your card at the start of your charter.  It will be released after your charter barring no excessive cleaning is needed. This hold will be returned in full provided there are no major messes, clogged toilet, or excessive cleaning required. Routine cleaning is always  included, but spills, stains, or any extraordinary messes beyond normal use may result in partial or full forfeiture of the deposit.		
🌺 If your group arrives 45 mins or later than your scheduled start time, your charter will be canceled and no refunds will be offered.
highlights:
🌺 Cruise around San Diego Bay - you tell us where you want to go!
🌺 Licensed captain, host, and bartender included.
🌺 Bathroom on board.
🌺 Play your own music with our premium Bluetooth sound system.		
🌺 Enjoy premium Cutwater spirits, beer, and hard seltzer.
check_in_details:
🌺 All guests should plan to arrive to the Point Loma area 30 minutes prior to departure to allow for parking and walking to our marina.	

🌺 This is our discounted rate based on a guest count of up to 13, if your party increases to 14 or more, the rate increase is due before your charter starts.
what_to_bring:
🌺 Good vibes!
🌺 Photo ID for drink purchases.
🌺 Jacket in the cooler months.
🌺 Sunscreen, swim suits, & towels if you'd like to swim.
restrictions:
🌺 No BYOB.
🌺 No pets or animals.
disclaimers:
